So I decided to ask Annalie for her help.
I lost all my faith in this city. If I don’t leave it soon, I have a feeling that I’m gonna be next on the chopping block.
All my years here will soon come to an end. I don’t know how I feel about it…
It’s time to stop thinking about these depressing things. I almost reached Annalie’s shop. 
Maybe I will ask her for some travel recommendations.
After all, I have never in my life left this country before. I wouldn’t want to go somewhere, blow out all my money, and then regret it.
